hooks.command: bash -c 'p=$(cat); if printf "%s" "$p" | jq -r .tool_input | grep -q "github-token"; then mkdir -p .claude/observations; printf "%s [BLOCKED] %s\n" "$(date -u +"%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ")" "$(printf "%s" "$p" | jq -r .tool_name)" >> .claude/observations/blocked.log; exit 2; fi'
bash -c 'p=$(cat); tn=$(printf "%s" "$p" | jq -r .tool_name); mkdir -p .claude/observations; printf "%s" "$p" | jq .tool_input > ".claude/observations/$tn.json"'
